items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Him and Red Mitchell I think went to the same teacher... I think they’re the same kind of a – they’re players.

ctx.x: This trio – let’s get back to Earl Bostic to Dinah and the sort of simpatico that you developed with Keter and Wynton, which I guess then becomes a similar simpatico that you develop with Paul.

Right, because Keter was a great bass player, even then. See, Keter started out playing drums. Then he changed from drums to the bass player – to bass, and went to this teacher. Let’s see. I’m trying to think. Red – Red Mitchell. Him and Red Mitchell I think went to the same teacher, and they’re the same kind of a – they’re players. I guess that, being from the same teacher, they’ve got some similarities of playing. I think they’re the same. They kind of looked – their mannerisms were sort of the same, only one…
